title: A root session waiting in termal_resume_after_delegations gets no mailbox wakes until the fan-in fires, so a coordinator can't schedule during a long review
outcome: A root session waiting in termal_resume_after_delegations gets no mailbox wakes until the fan-in fires, so a coordinator can't schedule during a long review
acceptance: While a root session has an open termal_resume_after_delegations wait, a new mailbox message can start an ordinary turn for that session; the delegation wait stays armed and still delivers its fan-in prompt once the delegations finish, exactly once; a test shows a mailbox wake handled during an open wait and the later fan-in still delivered.
The fan-in prompt is never lost or duplicated by an intervening mailbox turn, and a fan-in that becomes ready during an active mailbox turn is queued and delivered after it; a test shows it.
The sender's notificationDisposition reflects the actual state (for example woken during an open wait) rather than a paused queue; a test shows it.
